hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''); exit(1 if 'secret' in p.lower() else 0)"

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''); exit(0 if p.endswith('.yaml') else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then esphome config dashboard-epaper.yaml 2>&1 || true; fi
